entries.Summary: An IELTS test report record: bordered document card with the IELTS lockup and an ACADEMIC badge, the printed admissions note, a centre/date/candidate strip, candidate detail fields, a five-column band row whose overall band is chosen from a select, and an administrator comment box beside a validation stamp ring. Transcribed from the ielts-report mock. [Category: education · 7 fields · uses: Text, Date, Select]
